collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2004 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 2004 to 2007 (C203) model requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slider Fit wiper arm attachment and all of the following blades will fit. We also have rear blade for this C Class Estate, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
